title: 기술대학설립ㆍ운영규정시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text: Article 5 (Submission of Deliberation Results) Where the University Establishment Review Committee under Article 3 of the Regulations on the Establishment and Operation of Universities receives a request for deliberation on important matters concerning establishment and operation of a technical college under Article 7 of the Decree, it shall submit the results of deliberation to the Minister of Education within one month from the date it receives the request. <Amended on February 2, 1999; January 31, 2001; March 30, 2004; March 4, 2008; March 23, 2013>
